name: Ravi
description: A Tolgath who rang the Apocalypse Chime, was trapped in a coffin, and was freed and renamed Grandmother Sengir by Baron Sengir.

description_citations.text: "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A plague of rats kills most of Ravi's village, including her mother; she meets the baron's son, who teaches her a song to control the rats to kill the baron.
timeline.quote: To do this, the boy taught her a song that could control the rats.

citation.text: "Ravi Sengir", section "Before Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ravi commands the rats to kill the baron after finding him working on her mother's corpse; the baron's boy is revived by his father's last spell.
timeline.quote: Ravi took her opportunity and ordered the rats to kill the baron.

citation.text: "Ravi Sengir", section "Before Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ravi is introduced to the new Baron Sengir, who is intolerant of light.
timeline.quote: Ravi was thus introduced to the new Baron Sengir .

citation.text: "Ravi Sengir", section "Before Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the peak of the Great War on Ulgrotha, Ravi rings the Apocalypse Chime, destroying both parties and causing the Great Destruction.
timeline.quote: Ravi rang the chime and destroyed both parties, resulting in the Great Destruction that formed the Dead Zone

citation.text: "Ravi Sengir", section "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ravi hides in a magical coffin in the Basalt Spire and is trapped in it for centuries, driven mad.
timeline.quote: Trapped, Ravi lay in stasis, awake, unable to dream, aware of every passing second for the centuries she was locked within the artifact.

citation.text: "Ravi Sengir", section "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The vampire Baron Sengir frees Ravi, neither recognizing the other, and takes her to his castle as Grandmother Sengir and his tutor.
timeline.quote: she was freed by her childhood friend, the Baron Sengir , now a full-fledged vampire

citation.text: "Ravi Sengir", section "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On the eve of the Mending, Sengir and Ihsan leave Ulgrotha at the head of a vampire army; Ravi stays and later defends Ulgrotha in the Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: Grandmother Sengir stayed behind on Ulgrotha, and participated in the plane's defense during the New Phyrexian Invasion .

citation.text: "Ravi Sengir", section "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ravi rings the Apocalypse Chime, propagating damage across planes.
timeline.quote: When Ravi rang the Apocalypse Chime

citation.text: "Rift", section "Madaran rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Young Sengir and the orphan Ravi lead plague rats against the baron; the rats kill the boy and the baron, and Sengir revives as a vampire.
timeline.quote: However, he was visibly hurt by the sunlight and receded to a dark corner of the room, hinting at his now complete transformation into a vampire.

citation.text: "Sengir", section "Before Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sengir frees the mad crone Ravi from a sealed coffin in the Dead Zone and names her Grandmother Sengir.
timeline.quote: In any case, the baron quickly sensed the magical prowess of the woman and he brought her to his castle , renaming her Grandmother Sengir .

citation.text: "Sengir", section "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ravi rings the Apocalypse Chime, ending the Great War.
timeline.quote: Ravi ends this war by ringing the Apocalypse Chime

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The "Empty Quarter" (3000 AR to 3285 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Tolgath Ravi rings the Apocalypse Chime, ending the war and devastating the whole plane.
timeline.quote: the Tolgath Ravi rang the Apocalypse Chime

citation.text: "Ulgrotha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Chime kills all creatures, and the land becomes the Dead Zone that drains mana and life; Ravi hides in a coffin and cannot free herself.

citation.text: "Ulgrotha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Baron Sengir frees the mad Ravi from her coffin and renames her Grandmother Sengir.
timeline.quote: He freed her from the coffin, and brought her with him, renaming her Grandmother Sengir.

citation.text: "Ulgrotha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Grandmother Sengir stays behind to defend the plane when Ulgrotha becomes a target of the New Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: Grandmother Sengir stayed behind and was part of the planes' defense

citation.text: "Ulgrotha", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A former planeswalker who rang the Apocalypse Chime, destroying both factions of Ulgrotha's Great War, was trapped for centuries in a coffin, and is now the adopted grandmother and tutor of Baron Sengir.

citation.text: "Ravi Sengir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: The figure who rang the Apocalypse Chime.

citation.text: "Rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: An orphan girl who helped Sengir kill his father and was later freed from a coffin as a mad crone, becoming his teacher of black magic.

citation.text: "Sengir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A child who rings the Apocalypse Chime on Ulgrotha and is trapped in a coffin for 220 years.
